preconditions.description: The number of employees n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of pairs of people who don't like each other m must be between 0 and 100,000.
The number of salary revisions q must be between 0 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n and a_i != b_i for a_i, b_i in dislikes)
preconditions.description: Each pair of employees who dislike each other must be valid and distinct.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v_i <= n for v_i in revisions)
preconditions.description: Each employee v_i mentioned in the salary revisions must be a valid employee number.

postconditions.description: The output must contain q + 1 integers representing the number of dangerous triples at the beginning of each day.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) for x in output)
postconditions.description: Each element in the output must be an integer.
The first output integer must represent the number of dangerous triples at the beginning of the first day.

postconditions.expression: output[i] == count_dangerous_triples(state_after_revision(i)) for i in range(1, q + 1)
postconditions.description: Each subsequent output integer must represent the number of dangerous triples after the corresponding salary revision.
